events.title: MTV Launched 45 Years Ago
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" as its first broadcast video.

angles.name: MTV Impact
angles.copy: Remember the day music television changed forever? 45 years ago, MTV burst onto our screens, kicking off with The Buggles. What was the first music video that truly blew your mind?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 Years On
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, the Woodstock Festival began – three days of peace, love, and music that defined a generation. If you could have been there, which artist would you have wanted to see most?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, we lost the King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to inspire generations. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Sending a huge shout-out to Chrissie Hynde, who celebrates her 75th birthday today! A true rock icon with The Pretenders. What's your go-to Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis to his solo work, he's always delivered pure rock 'n' roll. Which Liam track are you cranking today?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, commemorating the release of the first James Bond film, "Dr. No," in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating 007 and over six decades of iconic espionage. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and enduring spirit of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?
